title: Compatibility of etale evaluation with a base-change unit
statement: Let R, X and Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme], W→R an etale object [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and H an abelian sheaf on Y [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let h:X→Y, f:Y→R, g:X→R satisfy g=h f. Put Vf=W×_R Y and Vg=W×_R X [def-pc-fibre-product], with etale projections p:Vf→Y and q:Vg→X. Let m:Vg→Vf preserve the W-projection and satisfy m p=q h. Define E_V:H(V)≅Γ(V,V^{-1}H) by identity-object evaluation, inverse-image/restriction comparison [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction], and terminal evaluation. Then the W-component of f_* of the h-unit followed by f_*h_*≅g_* [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], then E_Vg for h^{-1}H, equals E_Vf followed by global pullback along m and Γ of c_{m,p}^{-1} c_{q,h}; these are the explicitly specified upperStarComp components for common composite m p=q h [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. This is unit compatibility for arbitrary H, before any transport from h^{-1}f^{-1}G to g^{-1}G.

proof.text: Set Vf=W×_R Y, Vg=W×_R X, p=Vf→Y and q=Vg→X. Construct i:Vg→Vf×_Y X as the pullback lift of m and q. Construct its inverse from the projection Vf×_Y X→Vf→W and its projection to X. The universal property and hm, hm' and g=h f verify the two inverse identities. Thus the square (h,p,m,q) is cartesian.

Apply etale_restriction_pullback_unit with this i to H. Cancel its two invertible restriction comparisons, and compose with the terminal-evaluation/global-sections isomorphisms. The resulting outside components are exactly etaleObjectSectionsIso Vf and etaleObjectSectionsIso Vg.

Identify theta with the inverse terminal pullback comparison by its two projections. Identify the composite h-unit and restriction along i with the W-component of lowerStar f of the unit followed by lowerStarComp, using the canonical pullback-pasting isomorphism. Move the composition comparison past terminal evaluation by naturality. These identifications give precisely the asserted equality of homomorphisms.

theorem etaleObjectSections_baseChange {R X Y : Scheme.{u}} (W : R.Etale)
    (h : X ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ R) (g : X ⟶ R) (w : g = h ≫ f)
    (m : pullback W.hom g ⟶ pullback W.hom f)
    (hm : m ≫ pullback.fst W.hom f = pullback.fst W.hom g)
    (hm' : m ≫ pullback.snd W.hom f = pullback.snd W.hom g ≫ h)
    (H : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let Vf := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W
    let Vg := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g).obj W
    (((lowerStar A f).map ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A h).unit.app H) ≫
        (lowerStarComp A h f g w).hom.app _).hom.app (op W)) ≫
        (etaleObjectSectionsIso Vg).hom.app ((upperStar A h).obj H) =
      (etaleObjectSectionsIso Vf).hom.app H ≫
        globalSectionsUpperStarMap A m ((upperStar A Vf.hom).obj H) ≫
        (Sheaf.Γ Vg.left.smallEtaleTopology A).map
          ((upperStarComp A m Vf.hom (m ≫ Vf.hom) rfl).inv.app H ≫
            (upperStarComp A Vg.hom h (m ≫ Vf.hom) hm').hom.app H)
